item.title: 1.11.0 (ARM64)
item.description:
What's New in 1.11.0

  • Your custom vocabulary now reaches more providers. Grok, Mistral with your own key, Google Chirp 3 and OpenAI gpt-transcribe all read your terms. Before, they were sent nowhere.
  • Three new post-processing models: Gemini 3.7 Flash, Grok 4.6 and GPT-5.6 Luna. Modes set to a retired model move to a current one on their own.
  • Clearer provider and model pickers. The Provider list names the company, the Model list names the model, and Google no longer appears twice.
  • New modes start with the English spelling for your region. Modes you already made keep their setting.
  • A provider error during streaming now shows one clear message, instead of replacing it with a misleading reconnection failure.
  • Links in the update window are now clickable.

item.title: 1.10.0 (ARM64)
item.description:
What's New in 1.10.0

  • Find the fastest provider for you — the new latency page shows how quickly every cloud provider actually answers, broken down by server region and clip length, from real transcriptions rather than vendor claims. Pick the fastest one for where you are. Your transcriptions help build it: Share anonymous speed data in Settings → General is on by default and stores only a timing — no account, no audio, no text. Turn it off any time.
  • Release notes now show bold text instead of raw tags.

item.title: 1.9.0 (ARM64)
item.description:
What's New in 1.9.0

  • New models — OpenAI gpt-transcribe and gpt-live-transcribe, AssemblyAI Universal-3.5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 5, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Grok 4.5, Mistral Medium 3.5 and more.
  • Live dictation with Deepgram now works properly — it no longer stops after 10 seconds or drops words mid-sentence.
  • Live dictation no longer loses a finished transcription, and starting a recording right after launch is now reliable.
  • Long dictations through Groq are now cleaned up properly instead of falling back to the raw transcript.
  • "Remove filler words" now applies to live dictation.
  • Fixed vocabulary replacements trimming your text when no vocabulary was set.
  • Fixed lost paragraph breaks in dictated text, and a crash when exporting backup settings.

item.title: 1.8.3 (ARM64)
item.description:
What's New in 1.8.3

  • Short recordings transcribe faster with AssemblyAI — clips under two minutes now finish in a single request instead of upload-then-wait.
  • Your vocabulary replacements now apply on modes that have AI post-processing turned off. They were being silently discarded.
  • Removed Groq's Llama 4 Maverick, which Groq has shut down. Picking it made AI post-processing quietly do nothing; modes still set to it now move to GPT-OSS 120B automatically.
  • Fixed a bug where a finished transcription could be overwritten in History with "Transcription did not finish", losing its text. The text was pasted correctly at the time — only the saved copy was destroyed.
  • The mouse wheel now scrolls the Modes and Model Library pages, instead of only the scrollbar working.

item.title: 1.7.0 (ARM64)
item.description:
What's New in 1.7.0

    New Design

    • Refreshed app design across the whole app, matching the Mac experience
    • Redesigned Model Library with star ratings and sortable columns
    • New home screen with a built-in stats bar

    New Features

    • Real-time streaming transcription as you speak
    • On-device AI for offline post-processing (no cloud needed)
    • Local API server so other apps can transcribe through HyperWhisper
    • New offline models: Qwen3-ASR and Nemotron, plus ARM64 support
    • New cloud providers: Microsoft, Google Chirp 3, Grok, and Gemini 3.5 Flash
    • Section-by-section backup and restore
    • Automatic filler-word removal (um, uh) even without post-processing

    Improvements & Fixes

    • Better GPU detection across more hardware
    • More reliable recovery if a recording is interrupted
    • Smarter clipboard handling and faster cloud connections
    • Bug fixes and stability improvements
